               <note type="gloss">'di yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs>'i rigs pa yin</note>gsum pa zid ba yod pa la me yod pas khyab pa dang me med sa la du ba med pas khyab pa gnyi ga nges pa na me mhed kyi dngos po ma yin dgag na du ba khegs sam ma khegs mi khegs na rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa'i khyab pa gnyi ga nges kyang 'dog pa phyogs gcig la the tshol za ba mi ldog pa
               <lb n="N006"/>'gyur ro ||</seg></TEI>
